purpose.summary: This program (ORCR0103) is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software for Japan. It creates print files for medical insurance receipts (レセプト印刷用ファイル作成), processing indexed receipt data files (RECE02, RECE031, RECE061, RECE09, RECE11) and generating output for insurance claim submission. It handles multiple insurance types including national health insurance and handles special cases such as public expense claims.

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in latin-1 but the Japanese comments are actually Shift-JIS or EUC-JP, causing mojibake in the decoded text. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 181705 bytes (4163 lines total), but the visible portion is sufficient for confident classification. No COPY book bodies are shown (they are referenced by filename), so PIC count of 240 reflects only inline definitions.
